scope_findings.claim: The fellow (Dr. Rositsa Cholakova) undertakes international mobility, moving to the recruiting host HUN-REN ATK in Martonvasar, Hungary, as an incoming researcher.
The application is made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic sector (HUN-REN ATK).
The action comprises a 24-month European Fellowship at ATK, i.e. within the standard 12-24 month duration for a European Postdoctoral Fellowship.
An additional non-academic placement of up to six months (AgroVIR, M25-M30, Hungary, operational/FMIS evaluation) is included at the end of the project as an integral, evaluated part of the proposal.
Total project duration is 30 months, structured as a 24-month European Fellowship plus a 6-month non-academic placement.
The project's scientific objective is to build and validate a physiologically grounded, crop-configurable water-stress irrigation decision-support framework using processing tomato as the model crop.
